reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Backend-calculated financial reports for any period, with every currency kept separate.

descriptions.overview: A dashboard-ready view of income, cash flow, balances, budgets, savings, debts and recurring forecasts.
descriptions.income-expense: Income and expense for the period, compared with the previous one, with top categories and transactions.
descriptions.cash-flow: Money in and out of your accounts, split into operating, transfer, savings and debt movements.
descriptions.accounts: Inflow, outflow and net change per account, with current balances.
descriptions.categories: Ledger totals per category for the period.
descriptions.transfers: Transfers between your accounts, with principal and fees kept apart.
descriptions.budgets: How much of each budget has been used, as calculated by the budget service.
descriptions.savings-goals: Savings goal funding and the contributions and withdrawals made during the period.
descriptions.debts: What you owe and what you're owed, kept separate, with payments and collections.
descriptions.recurring: Recurring templates as a forecast, next to the occurrences that were actually posted.

notes.overview: Every figure is aggregated by the backend, per currency. Different currencies are never added together or converted.
notes.incomeExpense: Transfers, savings movements and debt principal aren't counted as income or expense.
notes.cashFlow: Movements are split into operating, transfer, savings and debt buckets. Internal transfers net to zero overall, and a reversal cancels the original movement in its period.
notes.accounts: Opening balance is account metadata and isn't counted as period inflow. Current balances come from the backend balance service.
notes.categories: Category totals come from the ledger: refunds reduce expense totals and reversals cancel the original amount.
notes.transfers: Transfer principal is shown separately from fees and is never income or expense. Internal transfer legs net to zero, and a reversal cancels the original ledger impact.
notes.budgets: Only posted expenses consume a budget. Transfers and reversed expenses don't. Progress is calculated by the backend.
notes.savingsGoals: Contributions and withdrawals are savings movements, not income or expense. Funding is calculated by the backend.
notes.debts: Payable and receivable amounts are kept separate. Debt principal and settlements are debt movements, not income or expense.
notes.recurring: Recurring templates are a forecast only. Actual figures come from posted occurrences, the only ones that are real transactions.
